subject: planner: enable cd-c algorithm by default for join reorder (#66349)
summary: Reviewed the commit diff vs parent, focusing on planner join reorder enablement and outer-join semantics handling. The change routes JoinReOrderSolver to the CD-C-based join reorder by default via session var, adds explicit outer-join reorder gating, improves non-inner edge direction handling, and aligns NOT_NULL flags in reordered outer-join conditions. No remaining Blocker/High correctness/SQL-semantics/compatibility issues were identified in the touched planner code.
